meta.name: video-fetch-and-summarize
meta.description: Downloads videos from URLs and generates a Markdown summary for each one using the Gemini API. Supports custom prompts to extract specific information instead of the default summary. Each video is saved in its own subfolder containing the MP4 file and a summary.md. Use this skill when the user provides video URLs directly, or a file (Markdown, TXT, or any text file) containing video URLs, and wants both the video downloaded and summarized. Triggers on requests like "download and summarize these videos", "fetch these links and summarize", "process this list of video links", "extract X from these videos", or when given a file with URLs and asked for summaries. Supports Instagram, YouTube, TikTok, Twitter/X, Facebook, and 1000+ other platforms. Requires GEMINI_API_KEY environment variable.
